description: One-call due diligence for a Base token before buying, accepting or listing it: owner powers in the contract (mint, pause, blacklist, fees, proxy), who holds the supply (top wallets, concentration), whether it can actually be sold and its real buy/sell tax (simulated), and whether the token or its owner is on the OFAC sanctions list or a scam blacklist. Returns one verdict (ok, caution, avoid, known issuer), a 0-100 risk score and plain reasons. Not charged for invalid input. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
name: token_report
title: Token due diligence in one call: owner powers, holder concentration and blocklists, with one verdict
